propositions: Rich-text encoding differs between Jira Cloud (ADF JSON) and Data Center (plain text/wiki markup), causing duplication in map_fields_to_remote and other call sites
A four-operation Protocol (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) is required to preserve Cloud's two distinct call paths which compose fit and normalize differently

AdfCodec must be implemented in adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py on the Cloud side; WikiTextCodec in adapters/jira_family/rich_text.py on the shared side; jira_family modules must import nothing from adapters/jira to maintain import contract
The single real implementation of map_fields_to_remote must relocate to adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py taking RichTextCodec as a dependency, with Cloud and DC backends delegating to it

WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767 chars) with marker ' … [truncated by reconciler]' counted against the limit; AdfCodec output must match pre-story behavior proven by J1 pinned oracle values
